column3: “Of Edom” is rendered “concerning Edom”; “arise, let us arise on it” is rendered “Arise and let us go against her,” and NASB adds “saying.”
Close to the Hebrew.
“Presumption” is rendered “arrogance”; “the height of his dwelling” is rendered “In the loftiness of your dwelling place,” and “the ground” “to earth.”
“If you will make high” is rendered “Though you build high.”
“Destroyers” is rendered “robbers”; “steal their sufficiency” is rendered “steal only until they had enough.”
“They will be plundered Esau” is rendered “Esau will be ransacked.”
“Your food” is rendered “They who eat your bread,” and “a trap” “an ambush”; NASB puts “There is no understanding in him” in parentheses.
Close to the Hebrew.
“Warriors” is rendered “mighty men.”
“From the violence of your brother” is rendered “Because of violence to your brother.”
“Standing from before” is rendered “stood aloof,” and “took captive” “carried off.”
“Look on” is rendered “gloat over,” and “make big your mouth” “boast”; “people of Judah” is rendered “sons of Judah.”
“His” is rendered “their”; “stretch out on” is rendered “loot.”
“Parting of ways” is rendered “fork of the road,” and “deliver up” “imprison.”
“Recompense” is rendered “dealings.”
“Like they had not been” is rendered “as if they had never existed.”
“Deliverance” is rendered “those who escape.”
NASB adds “Then” and “So that.”
NASB supplies “those of” and “plain”; “Philistines” is rendered “the Philistine plain.”
“The fortress” is rendered “host”; the meaning of the Hebrew is uncertain. “People of Israel” is rendered “sons of Israel,” and NASB adds “as far as.”
“To rule” is rendered “To judge,” and “the kingship” “the kingdom.”
